Donal O'Riordan strained a thigh muscle in the 800 which meant no 1500 for him later on - it's easy to see how the 12½ points difference between ourselves and Harlow opened up.

Donal O'Riordan bounced back from mild injury for the closest of victories in the 800m while for Jon Squirrel in the one lap race it was just too close for comfort: he got barged by the man supposed to be in the next lane out but actually in his own!

Now we'd like to introduce you to another runner from across the Irish Sea - Donal O'Riordan. Watching Donal race in some of our opening meetings this year one cannot help but be struck by the fact that he really does look every inch "a runner".
